tagline: Indus Valley Yoga teacher training, lineage-credentialed certification.
description_md: IVY (Indus Valley Yoga) is ERA Professionals' yoga-teacher-training certification, based on the Original Hot Yoga Teacher Training created by Olivia Anselmo of Liv for Yoga, LLC, covering the 26 postures and 2 breathing exercises of Bikram Chaudhry's original regimen. Instructors complete 200+ hours of study and practice and are certified as IVY Certified Hot Yoga Teachers, co-signed by Bilal Musharraf (Indus Valley Yoga) and Olivia Anselmo (Liv for Yoga, LLC). Certificates are issued with a QR code that scans back to the instructor's TrueSight DAO–anchored profile. Co-issued via TrueSight DAO so credentials are publicly verifiable and portable.
